title: Restaurant Profit Margin Calculator
description: Evaluate restaurant profit margin calculator using your menu, staffing, ordering channels and fulfilment needs before deciding on a software setup.
intro: Use your own figures in PKR. These are planning calculations, not a forecast, quote or promise of financial results.

sections.heading: Check the assumptions
sections.text: Compare the same period and order volume. Include payment fees, fulfilment, staffing and acquisition costs in your inputs. A lower software fee does not establish a higher operating profit.

sections.heading: Evaluate your actual software scope
sections.text: Restrova onboarding is PKR 10,000 once. Monthly software pricing is the higher of PKR 5,000 or 1% of sales processed through Restrova, not the sum of both. Confirm taxes, hardware and external services separately.

reviewNote: Functional tool; keep noindex until editorial review and rollout approval.
